activeSlice.scope: Add fail-closed Hunter V2 controlled-rollout readiness evaluation: shadow quality/safety evidence, canary eligibility, canary outcome guardrails, kill-switch conditions and explicit production-enable approval requirement. No rollout, deployment or production wiring is performed.
successCriteria: Shadow-to-canary readiness requires minimum run/Brand coverage, quality non-regression, retrieval coverage, bounded cost/latency and zero critical safety/tenant violations.
Canary-to-production readiness additionally requires minimum canary exposure, user-outcome non-regression and no kill-switch condition.
Exploration share and topic concentration must remain inside certified EEI policy bounds.
Any critical tenant, manipulation, persistence-authority or evidence-provenance violation forces hold/kill-switch.
Production readiness remains false unless a separate explicit human production-enable approval is supplied.
No production Hunter wiring, feature activation, Vercel deployment, scheduler change or persistence mutation is introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
